CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_CarWash_SalesSummary
        @StartDate  DATE,
        @EndDate    DATE,
        @BayId      INT = NULL,
        @OrderSource NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
    AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;

        DECLARE @StartDT DATETIME2 = CAST(@StartDate AS DATETIME2);
        DECLARE @EndDT   DATETIME2 = DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@EndDate AS DATETIME2));

        SELECT 
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.StatusCode IN (60, 70) THEN 1 END) AS TotalWashes,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.StatusCode = 60 THEN 1 END) AS TotalCompletedWashes,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.StatusCode = 70 THEN 1 END) AS TotalClosedWashes,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.StatusCode IN (40, 50) THEN 1 END) AS TotalActiveWashes,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN o.StatusCode = 80 THEN 1 END) AS TotalCancelledWashes,
            COUNT(*) AS TotalBookings,
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN o.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0.00) AS TotalRevenue,
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN o.PackagePrice ELSE 0 END), 0.00) AS TotalNetRevenue,
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN o.GSTAmount ELSE 0 END), 0.00) AS TotalGSTAmount,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                WHEN o.CustomerName IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(o.CustomerName))) NOT IN ('WALK-IN CUSTOMER', 'WALK-IN', 'WALKIN', '') 
                THEN UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(o.CustomerName)))
                WHEN o.MobileNumber IS NOT NULL AND RTRIM(LTRIM(o.MobileNumber)) NOT IN ('-', '') 
                THEN RTRIM(LTRIM(o.MobileNumber)) 
                ELSE NULL 
            END) AS TotalUniqueCustomers,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                WHEN o.VehicleNumber IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(o.VehicleNumber))) NOT IN ('WALK-IN', 'WALKIN', 'WALK IN', '-', '', 'N/A', 'NONE') 
                THEN UPPER(RTRIM(LTRIM(o.VehicleNumber))) 
                ELSE NULL 
            END) AS TotalUniqueVehicles,
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN 1 END) > 0 
                THEN ROUND(
                    SUM(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN o.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END) / 
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID' AND o.StatusCode != 80 THEN 1 END), 2
                )
                ELSE 0.00 
            END AS AverageOrderValue,
            ISNULL(AVG(CASE 
                WHEN o.StartedDate IS NOT NULL AND o.CompletedDate IS NOT NULL 
                THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, o.StartedDate, o.CompletedDate) 
                ELSE NULL 
            END), 0) AS AvgWashDurationMinutes
        FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
        WHERE o.CreatedDate >= @StartDT AND o.CreatedDate < @EndDT
          AND (@BayId IS NULL OR o.BayId = @BayId)
          AND (@OrderSource IS NULL OR o.OrderSource = @OrderSource);
    END;
storedProcedures.sp_CarWash_ServiceWiseSales:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_CarWash_ServiceWiseSales
        @StartDate DATE,
        @EndDate   DATE
    AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;

        DECLARE @StartDT DATETIME2 = CAST(@StartDate AS DATETIME2);
        DECLARE @EndDT   DATETIME2 = DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@EndDate AS DATETIME2));

        SELECT 
            c.ServiceCategoryId,
            c.CategoryName AS ServiceCategoryName,
            p.PackageId,
            p.PackageName,
            COUNT(o.OrderId) AS TotalWashes,
            ISNULL(SUM(o.PackagePrice), 0.00) AS NetSales,
            ISNULL(SUM(o.GSTAmount), 0.00) AS GSTSales,
            ISNULL(SUM(o.TotalAmount), 0.00) AS GrossRevenue,
            ROUND(
                COUNT(o.OrderId) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(o.OrderId)) OVER(), 0), 2
            ) AS WashSharePercentage,
            ROUND(
                SUM(o.TotalAmount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(o.TotalAmount)) OVER(), 0), 2
            ) AS RevenueSharePercentage
        FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
        INNER JOIN dbo.ServicePackageMaster p ON o.PackageId = p.PackageId
        INNER JOIN dbo.ServiceCategoryMaster c ON o.ServiceCategoryId = c.ServiceCategoryId
        WHERE o.CreatedDate >= @StartDT AND o.CreatedDate < @EndDT
          AND o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID'
          AND o.StatusCode != 80
        GROUP BY c.ServiceCategoryId, c.CategoryName, p.PackageId, p.PackageName
        ORDER BY GrossRevenue DESC;
    END;
storedProcedures.sp_CarWash_RecentWashes:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_CarWash_RecentWashes
          @TopCount INT = 100,
          @StartDate DATE = NULL,
          @EndDate DATE = NULL
      AS
      BEGIN
          SET NOCOUNT ON;

          SELECT TOP (@TopCount)
              o.OrderId,
              o.OrderNo,
              o.CustomerName,
              o.VehicleNumber,
              vt.VehicleTypeName,
              p.PackageName,
              c.CategoryName AS ServiceCategoryName,
              o.BayId,
              b.BayName,
              o.TotalAmount,
              o.StatusCode,
              CASE o.StatusCode
                  WHEN 10 THEN 'DETAILS_SAVED'
                  WHEN 20 THEN 'PAYMENT_PENDING'
                  WHEN 30 THEN 'PAID'
                  WHEN 40 THEN 'BAY_ASSIGNED'
                  WHEN 50 THEN 'IN_SERVICE'
                  WHEN 60 THEN 'COMPLETED'
                  WHEN 70 THEN 'CLOSED'
                  WHEN 80 THEN 'CANCELLED'
                  ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
              END AS StatusName,
              o.StartedDate,
              o.CompletedDate,
              DATEDIFF(MINUTE, o.StartedDate, o.CompletedDate) AS DurationMinutes,
              o.CreatedDate
          FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
          LEFT JOIN dbo.VehicleTypeMaster vt ON o.VehicleTypeId = vt.VehicleTypeId
          LEFT JOIN dbo.ServicePackageMaster p ON o.PackageId = p.PackageId
          LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceCategoryMaster c ON o.ServiceCategoryId = c.ServiceCategoryId
          LEFT JOIN dbo.BayMaster b ON o.BayId = b.BayNumber
          WHERE (@StartDate IS NULL OR CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) >= @StartDate)
            AND (@EndDate IS NULL OR CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) <= @EndDate)
          ORDER BY o.OrderId DESC;
      END;
storedProcedures.sp_CarWash_RecentTransactions:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_CarWash_RecentTransactions
          @TopCount INT = 100,
          @StartDate DATE = NULL,
          @EndDate DATE = NULL
      AS
      BEGIN
          SET NOCOUNT ON;

          SELECT TOP (@TopCount)
              o.OrderId,
              o.OrderNo,
              o.CustomerName,
              o.VehicleNumber,
              p.PackageName,
              RTRIM(o.PayMode) AS PayMode,
              pm.Description AS PayModeDescription,
              o.PackagePrice AS NetAmount,
              o.GSTAmount,
              o.TotalAmount,
              o.PaymentStatus,
              o.PaymentReference,
              o.OrderSource,
              o.PaidDate,
              o.CreatedDate
          FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
          LEFT JOIN dbo.ServicePackageMaster p ON o.PackageId = p.PackageId
          LEFT JOIN dbo.Paymode pm ON RTRIM(o.PayMode) = RTRIM(pm.PayMode)
          WHERE o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID'
            AND (@StartDate IS NULL OR CAST(ISNULL(o.PaidDate, o.CreatedDate) AS DATE) >= @StartDate)
            AND (@EndDate IS NULL OR CAST(ISNULL(o.PaidDate, o.CreatedDate) AS DATE) <= @EndDate)
          ORDER BY o.OrderId DESC;
      END;
storedProcedures.sp_CarWash_CustomerVehicleSummary:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_CarWash_CustomerVehicleSummary
        @StartDate DATE,
        @EndDate   DATE
    AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;

        DECLARE @StartDT DATETIME2 = CAST(@StartDate AS DATETIME2);
        DECLARE @EndDT   DATETIME2 = DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@EndDate AS DATETIME2));

        -- Top 10 repeat vehicles
        SELECT TOP 10
            o.VehicleNumber,
            vt.VehicleTypeName,
            COUNT(o.OrderId) AS TotalVisits,
            SUM(o.TotalAmount) AS TotalSpent,
            MAX(o.CreatedDate) AS LastVisitDate
        FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
        LEFT JOIN dbo.VehicleTypeMaster vt ON o.VehicleTypeId = vt.VehicleTypeId
        WHERE o.CreatedDate >= @StartDT AND o.CreatedDate < @EndDT
          AND o.VehicleNumber NOT IN ('WALK-IN', '')
          AND o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID'
        GROUP BY o.VehicleNumber, vt.VehicleTypeName
        ORDER BY TotalVisits DESC, TotalSpent DESC;

        -- Top 10 repeat customers
        SELECT TOP 10
            o.CustomerName,
            o.MobileNumber,
            COUNT(o.OrderId) AS TotalOrders,
            SUM(o.TotalAmount) AS TotalSpent,
            MAX(o.CreatedDate) AS LastOrderDate
        FROM dbo.CarWashOrder o
        WHERE o.CreatedDate >= @StartDT AND o.CreatedDate < @EndDT
          AND o.CustomerName NOT IN ('Walk-in Customer', 'Walk-in')
          AND o.PaymentStatus = 'PAID'
        GROUP BY o.CustomerName, o.MobileNumber
        ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC, TotalSpent DESC;
    END;
